design_principle: An Archimedean spiral · the center is departure, the outer ring is Buddhahood · each turn represents a stage of mind-cultivation · the trajectory offset shows mind fluctuation
core_insight: Transforms the abstract concept of the 'unsettled mind-monkey and galloping ideas' into a quantifiable visual trajectory

key_events: Beneath Five Elements Mountain · Taking Refuge in Buddhism
spiral_stages.stage_summary: Wukong begins to rein in his nature, but his untamed spirit remains

key_events: Three Strikes at the White Bone Spirit · Dismissed
spiral_stages.stage_summary: Wukong is dismissed; his mind fluctuates violently — one of the spiral's greatest offset points

key_events: The Contest of Magic in Cart-Slow Kingdom
spiral_stages.stage_summary: After the Six-Eared Macaque is killed, Wukong's inner demon is eliminated and his mind stabilizes

spiral_stages.stage_name: Maturity · The Mind-Monkey Returns to Order
key_events: Borrowing the Fan at Flaming Mountain
The Great Battle of Lion-Camel Ridge
Saving the Children in Bhikshu Kingdom
spiral_stages.stage_summary: Wukong's mind tends toward serenity; the team enters its best state

key_events: The Rat Spirit of Bottomless Cave
Passing on Arts in Yuhua Prefecture
Shedding the Mortal Body at Lingyun Ferry · Attaining Buddhahood
spiral_stages.stage_summary: Master and disciples all attain the right fruit; the spiral reaches its outermost ring and the mind returns to zero

design_innovation: A fusion of ECG and mandala · minimalist black-and-white lines with plot symbols dotted along the spiral
